notes.title: Hardcore Mode is live NOW in Patch 1.2.4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983656/07a079b872f1739c733d0af5639b75bd66a7a73c.png

Hardcore Mode is here—and it’s not for the faint of heart.

You won’t see your location on the map. You won’t fast travel. You won’t get surrendering enemies, visual cues in combat, or even basic directions—unless you earn them.

Choose three (or more) permanent negative perks when you begin. Hardcore Mode reshapes how you play Kingdom Come: Deliverance II. No handholding. No shortcuts. Just you, your instincts, and a whole lot of trouble.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.2 – Fixes for trespassing, UI, and other issues 🛠️
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983656/1c0cfbb525f6f54b54ce7ff739ffb2f0e590b406.png

Hotfix 1.2.2 is here!

This update brings several key fixes to improve your experience in Kingdom Come: Deliverance II. Say farewell to uninvited trespassing warnings in your rented rooms, worry less about accidentally overwriting your playlines, and enjoy a more stable experience overall.

Fixes and Improvements 🔧

 Room Renting: No more trespassing flags in rented rooms after leaving and returning.
 UI: Removed New Game from the in-game pause menu to prevent accidental save overwrites.
 Into the Underworld Quest: Fixed Goatskin disappearing when loading saves from version 1.1.X after updating.
 Other Fixes: Resolved a bug where closing the barber overlay with a mouse would break the main menu.

Thank you for your patience and support—more updates are on the way!

Read the full patch notes here.

We’re also adding Barber Mode, so you can finally get a fresh new look in Zhelejov and Kuttenberg. On top of that, expect a wave of fixes and improvements, refining everything from combat mechanics to NPC behavior.
